en: Black‑and‑white historic street view showing a straight cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story masonry buildings in European late‑19th/early‑20th‑century style. Shops occupy the ground floors, with large display windows and an awning on the right. People in period clothing, including women with long skirts and hats and children playing, walk along the sidewalks and street. At the top in red script is a caption indicating the town and street name: 'Hartha i. Sa. Albertstrasse.'
